reviewEvidence.method: criterion-by-criterion review, concurrency-gap correction, hosted exact-source CI and focused post-merge replay
reviewEvidence.finding: Import manifests preserve source evidence and provenance; validation/conflict handling fail closed; retries and concurrent imports are checkpointed and idempotent; rollback preserves pre-import state; authorized imported media enters canonical browse/search/organization/sharing without inaccessible metadata leakage.
